key_insight: Zero-noise extrapolation can improve QAOA landscape accuracy while producing slightly worse parameter choices, so lower estimation error does not guarantee better optimization decisions.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate mitigation with decision regret alongside estimation error, using matched total shot budgets.
method: Simulate depth-one QAOA for MaxCut on 4–6 qubits over 120×120 parameter grids.
Compare Richardson extrapolation orders 1–3 against unmitigated estimates at equal shot budgets.
Use paired confirmation runs and exact moment analysis to distinguish residual-bias effects from amplified sampling noise.
evidence_signal: All four conditions retained by Holm testing were reproduced in 100 fresh paired repetitions each, with median MSE improvements of 7.65–73.09% but median normalized regret increases of 0.0031–0.0073.
watch_item: Decision losses were rare and small; exploratory seed collisions and reliance on simulated exhaustive grids limit conclusions about hardware or optimizer loops.
paper_title: Decision-aware validation of zero-noise extrapolation in QAOA optimization landscapes
